title: Atlas Launcher 1.8.2
summary: Fixes Windows shortcuts, the Atlas icon and uninstall cleanup.

sections.title: Installation and icons
items: Desktop and Start menu shortcuts are no longer incorrectly disabled when Windows shell folders have shared permissions.
Installation and launcher updates notify Windows of icon changes so it can replace the cached old artwork with the Atlas logo.

sections.title: Uninstallation
items: Old updater files are removed so the empty Atlas Launcher installation directory can be deleted.
Atlas settings, game files and unrecognized additional files are preserved. The uninstaller explains when additional files keep its directory from being removed.
Use the 1.8.2 installer to receive the corrected uninstaller as well.
